accepted_scope: Original precursor/acid retention and fresh sulfur contrast only, with complete phase/gas/atom/charge ownership. The old solid remains in donor, old aqueous S is separately transferred, and new receiver solid matches actual precursor loss.

First-order thiosulfate/proton activity with locally frozen activity coefficient and finite consumed analytical acid; actual times, pH and temperatures recorded. No continuously coupled buffering, isothermal or calibrated absolute-rate claim.

Below-threshold pending atmospheric CO2 credits are separately reported unapplied external transfer claims, not canonical owned carbon or measured uptake. No such credit is silently discarded or booked as additional molecules.
Retained canonical SO2 gas establishes phase/material bookkeeping only, not validated physical open-vessel mass transfer, venting or gas-release rate.
